answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}2^x3^x-(3^x)^2-9(2^x-3^x)&=0\\3^x(2^x-3^x)-9(2^x-3^x)&=0\\(2^x-3^x)(3^x-9)&=0.\end{align*}$$
Thus $2^x=3^x$ or $3^x=9$.
$$\begin{align*}\left(\frac23\right)^x&=1\\x&=0,\end{align*}$$
or $3^x=3^2$, giving $x=2$.

At $x=0$, both sides are $0$. At $x=2$, both sides are $-45$. Hence $x=0,2$.
